Q8137.reason: The act of State doctrine treats the legality of a sovereign act alleged as a tort as non-justiciable, leaving that assessment to the executive rather than the courts.

Q5849.reason: A bare claim that computer records were kept in the regular course of business does not supply the authentication and reliability foundation the business-records rule requires.

Q5779.reason: UK infusion standards (RCN and the Royal Marsden) call for an unused peripheral cannula to be flushed with 0.9% saline at least every 12 hours.
